schema.name: user
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE user (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	country_code VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	mobile VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	bonus_credits INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	free_review_quota INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	invited_by INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), status TEXT DEFAULT "normal", last_active_at TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(invited_by) REFERENCES user (id)
)

schema.name: ix_user_mobile
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_user_mobile ON user (mobile)

schema.name: blacklist
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE blacklist (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	blacklist_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	value VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), ban_type TEXT DEFAULT 'manual', input_preview TEXT, trigger_rule TEXT, is_unbanned BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0, unbanned_by TEXT, unban_reason TEXT, unbanned_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: ix_blacklist_value
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_blacklist_value ON blacklist (value)

schema.name: intercept_logs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE intercept_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	ip VARCHAR(45) NOT NULL, 
	request_path VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	trigger_word VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	text_preview TEXT, 
	action VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: record
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE record (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	report_markdown TEXT, 
	metadata_json TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), raw_output TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES user (id)
)

schema.name: feedback
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE feedback (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	report_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	feedback_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	categories TEXT, 
	comment TEXT, 
	upload_consent BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	contract_text TEXT, 
	contract_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	quality_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	suggested_bonus INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ai_reason TEXT, 
	bonus_awarded INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME, 
	reviewer_id INTEGER, 
	reviewed_by VARCHAR(50), 
	reject_reason TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES user (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reviewer_id) REFERENCES user (id)
)

schema.name: bonus_log
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE bonus_log (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	bonus_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	contract_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	awarded_amount INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES user (id)
)

schema.name: invite_rewards
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE invite_rewards (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	inviter_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	invitee_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reward_credits INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	invitee_first_review_at DATETIME, 
	reward_granted_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(inviter_id) REFERENCES user (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(invitee_id) REFERENCES user (id)
)

schema.name: file_hash_cache
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE file_hash_cache (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	file_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR, 
	first_upload_time DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	last_upload_time DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	upload_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES user (id)
)

schema.name: task_record
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE task_record (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	task_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	file_size INTEGER, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	remaining_bonus INTEGER, 
	record_id INTEGER, 
	progress INTEGER, 
	result TEXT, 
	error TEXT, 
	metadata_json TEXT, 
	validation_json TEXT, 
	summary_json TEXT, 
	trace_id VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES user (id)
)

schema.name: ix_task_record_task_id
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_task_record_task_id ON task_record (task_id)

schema.name: reward_logs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE reward_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	amount INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	related_feedback_id INTEGER, 
	operator VARCHAR(50), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES user (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(related_feedback_id) REFERENCES feedback (id)
)

schema.name: admin_logs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE admin_logs (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	admin_user VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	target_value VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	detail TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: security_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE security_events (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	detail TEXT, 
	user_id VARCHAR(50), 
	ip VARCHAR(45), 
	meta_json TEXT, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: admins
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE admins (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

schema.name: ix_admins_username
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_admins_username ON admins (username)
